resolution.note: registry reads prune missing paths and report the count; adopt runs of outside-acceptance and standards-audit use scratch registries; tests in drift, standards-audit, outside-acceptance pass

title: Scripts never write scratch repositories into the host adopted registry, and registry reads prune missing paths
body:
Why: Fable 1115f slice 2; ~/.krn/adopted.json holds 165 scratch paths, 146 gone, so adopt --refresh-all and doctor pack-stale serve no real project (doctor on the host exits 65 for a scratch py row).
Outcome: outside-acceptance, standards-audit and first-day-walkthrough set KRN_ADOPTED_REGISTRY to a scratch file; registry reads prune missing paths and report the count.
Files: src/brain/adopted-registry.ts, scripts/outside-acceptance.ts, scripts/standards-audit.ts, scripts/first-day-walkthrough.ts, tests.
Proof: a test; the host registry is unchanged after a row run and has 0 missing entries.
